clusters.title: Expand AI Model Support and Management
clusters.summary: Users want support for additional AI models including Gemini, Claude, GPT, and Grok series, indicating the current model selection is limited. Additionally, they want more control over model updates in Docker deployments, suggesting the current update mechanism lacks flexibility for their deployment needs.
clusters.representative_need: Add support for additional AI models (Gemini, Claude, GPT, Grok series)
